claim: The 'complete set the preflight needs' claim is false for the in-process path: cmdLightsOut(args, commands) builds knownCommands from its second parameter; a caller that does not thread faff's COMMANDS registry makes all seven CLI-backed guardrails read absent (FAFF-899 floor), so the preflight refuses before mintLightsOut is called.

Same: the test-mechanism paragraph claims completeness but omits threading the COMMANDS registry into cmdLightsOut, so scenarios 1-4 stubs never fire; spec must name passing the full COMMANDS registry as bin/faff does.
